question: Which subdomains are covered by the most regulations and how many clauses does each regulation contribute?
cypher: MATCH (sd:SubDomain) OPTIONAL MATCH (sd)<-[:MAPPED_TO]-(c:Clause)-[:HAS_CLAUSE]->(r:Regulation) WITH sd, collect(DISTINCT r.regulationId) AS regulationIds, collect(DISTINCT c.clauseId) AS clauseIds, count(DISTINCT c) AS totalClauses WITH sd, size(regulationIds) AS regulationCount, totalClauses, regulationIds AS regulations, [regulationId IN regulationIds | WITH regulationId, size((sd)<-[:MAPPED_TO]-(c:Clause)-[:HAS_CLAUSE]->(r:Regulation {regulationId: regulationId})) AS clauseCount RETURN {regulation: regulationId, clauseCount: clauseCount} ] AS regulationClauseCounts RETURN sd.subDomainId, sd.name, regulationCount, totalClauses, regulationClauseCounts ORDER BY regulationCount DESC, totalClauses DESC;
